projects.title: Personal Planner — Modular Productivity & Habit OS
projects.description:
Ultra-fast personal planner and productivity command center with keyboard-first workflows, interactive Kanban boards, and habit tracking.

- **Keyboard-First Task Creation**: Cmd+K / Ctrl+K command palette and rapid chat-style task input.
- **Interactive Kanban Boards**: Fluid drag-and-drop task lifecycle management and project status tracking.
- **Habit Heatmap & Streak Engine**: GitHub-style visual consistency heatmaps with streak calculations.
- **High-Assurance Testing**: Comprehensive test pyramid with Jest unit tests, multi-tier Playwright E2E, and Axe-core WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits.
projects.tags: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, NextAuth.js, Playwright E2E, Jest

projects.title: Agent Second Brain — Autonomous AI Orchestration Suite
projects.description:
Enterprise-grade multi-agent governance system, knowledge vault, and autonomous GitHub issue solver.

- **Autonomous Issue Solver**: Event-driven GitHub Action that self-branches, writes code, runs quality gates, and opens verified PRs.
- **Custom MCP Servers**: Native mcp-progress-notifier & mcp-discord streaming agent telemetry, health metrics, and audit logs via webhooks.
- **Multimodal Visual QA Gate**: Headless browser automation executing automated Gemini Vision audits on preview deployments.
- **Zettelkasten Knowledge Vault**: Dynamic skill indexing, self-learning mistake memory, and architectural decision records (ADRs).
projects.tags: AI Multi-Agent Swarms, Model Context Protocol (MCP), TypeScript, Node.js, Gemini Vision AI, GitHub Actions, Obsidian

projects.title: Hexagonal Architecture & DDD Blueprint
projects.description: Enterprise-grade Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) implementation in TypeScript. Decouples core business domain logic from transport protocols and databases via explicit Ports and Adapters, enabling 100% mocked unit tests and modular framework swappability.
projects.tags: Architecture, Clean Code, TypeScript, DDD, Ports & Adapters, TDD
